plan.title: Service PR to Split Award PO

steps.note: Enable eRFX project creation for the PR flow.
Enable splitting quantities across vendors.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.

args.title: Service PR Technical RFQ Split Award

steps.note: Set the mandatory event title.
Commit the 30-minute event duration; the separate evaluation duration is not configurable by this catalog step.
Fill remaining mandatory create-screen fields as the closest available support for the required terms configuration.
Invite exactly two QA test vendors without inventing supplier names.
Publish the configured Technical + RFQ event.
Verify the event reached a real published project page.
Have the first invited vendor answer the technical stage and submit a 100-per-activity quote.
Verify the first vendor's submission was accepted.
Have the second invited vendor answer the technical stage and submit a 90-per-activity quote.
Verify the second vendor's submission was accepted.
Wait for the bidding window to end before evaluation and awarding.
Score and submit the vendors' technical responses as the assigned evaluator.
Open the comparison grid after bidding and technical evaluation.
Verify both real vendor columns are present.
Verify the lower-priced second vendor ranks first.
Enter the awarding flow to split the two activities.
Award six units of the first activity to the lower-priced vendor.
Award four units of the second activity to the other vendor.
Verify both activities and both vendors are selected and the split proposal totals 6×90 plus 4×100.
Create the proposal from the allocated award.
Verify the award proposal was created and submitted.
Approve the submitted proposal with the required remark.
Complete approval and create the purchase orders from the award.
Verify the resulting purchase orders contain the two awarded activity lines.
Navigate to the events list to verify the event reached history.
Open the History tab.
Verify this plan's event appears in event history.
